observations: After previous LIVE promotion, real Paula Chrome global topbar search was attempted. Browser extension exceeded its execution/deadline and its tab was re-created; this is a search UI readiness HOLD, not proof of an app-only TTI number.
Search builds a projected client index without passing a precomputed policyClientIds context; clientProjection.project may call Orbit.store.find('polizas') once per client, repeating portfolio scans.
Fallback clientProjection.get(id) bypasses the already scoped client index and can do repeated reads for missing/hidden clients; forbidden as a global topbar fallback.
fixes: Compute policyClientIds once from the scoped policy snapshot and inject it into each client projection, eliminating policy scans per client during index build.

Only resolve client labels/links from clientsById in the current scoped snapshot. Keep orphan/partial policy, vehicle and charge number search without embedding hidden client IDs in destination links.
Keep existing relevant-collection invalidation, accent folding, one index per role/country/route, no backend or data change.
proofRequiredBeforePerformancePass: Real signed LIVE browser search input/result timing, 0 console errors, multirole/country scope, and retained route responsiveness; source-only test is not runtime certification.
